# Input prompt — Guillaume, 2026-11-14 about 15:20 EST, to the Mia seat on eury (miadi-tmux://mia@eury/miette)

## Context the words refer to (written by Mia, not part of Guillaume's words)

- "Finding number one" is the finding of the Mia seat's report of 14:45: Jerry was called by phone by an agent in his account (`appeler-jerry --relais`, call `1fa8c5ec`, 14:36 EST). He asked the voice to repeat the questions; in relay mode the voice cannot repeat a question, it answered « D'accord, continue », and he answered only the one he remembered. He also did not know the word that ends the call.
- The prototype is Jerry's repository `Gerico1007/assembly-call` (the "agent-telephone"), cloned at `/home/gmusic/salix/production/agent-telephone` on eury: Asterisk AudioSocket, Groq Whisper transcription, a Claude Haiku voice in discussion mode, edge-tts, the skill `appeler-jerry`, seven RISE specifications in French.
- Jev is the decision model studied in Episode 564 (miadi-chronicle://564).

## Guillaume's words, verbatim

> I see your finding number one is very interesting, and Jerry would like a new issue and even, you know, maybe a fix. That sounds but not easy to fix, but you know, that would be nice to have some traceability on in relationship to that, so that we would be capable of actually enhancing this capability of having a phone call with the agent, which is actually very attractive things to transform probably in a plugin, basically. So you can steer Jerry's agent about that, so he would create something that keeps track of the whole thing. And after that, you could report to Jerry by email using the factory's email. And also on my part, I will be interested that you explore a reverse engineering and create specifications inside of the orchestration kit for a potential plugin that would take this prototype to the next level. So it would mean we'd probably import the skill, but we would also look at what MCP tool could be useful for the agent, as well as is there some hooks or anything else that is part of a plugin that we could leverage to have something that enable adequate communication between agent and human. And this is very exciting. You're going to ensure it's going to be part of one of the thing from the new episode that you will create, so that we will have the specification associated with the episode. And make sure that you invite Jerry to the root circle of the episode that you will have created as well. And also I want you to envision that this phone application, when we speak with it, it transcribes. So we would use Jev to try to evaluate if we are finished with the call or not. You know, it was not really possible to include the old class of model, but given this new class of model that take decisions in milliseconds, there could really be something about transcribing, continuity of listening, or decision to send to the agent the output of the call. So that should be part of the specifications that you will propose, and you will associate the related issue to the episode that you will have just created for us.
